title: Do not generate one social image per platform; one 1200x630 og:image per locale covers every network
body: Facebook, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, Discord and Twitter all read the SAME og:image tag; they differ in how they crop, not in which file they request. So scripts/build-og.ts emits one card per locale (public/og.jpg, public/og.en.jpg). Accepted gap: the square crop some messaging clients use for the chat-list thumbnail loses the text edge; designing the main card to survive it would make it worse on the six platforms that show it whole. Reconsider only if data shows traffic arriving mostly through square thumbnails.
not_derivable: The per-platform image idea and the accepted square-crop loss are not mentioned in code.
